staff.name: Milica Perovic
staff.description:
Milica Perović – European Top Master Educator & Nail Care Expert

With over 10 years of experience in the nail care industry, I am proud to be a European Top Master Educator, having honed my skills through numerous advanced training programs and competitions, where I have earned first-place awards.

In Serbia, I had the honor of being both an ambassador and educator for the renowned brand KNS, training over 100 students who have gone on to refine their craft and succeed in the industry. My expertise extends to Russian Manicure and dual forms, where I specialize in creating flawless, elegant nails with precision and care.

I am committed to using only the highest-quality materials that are non-toxic, health-safe, and cruelty-free, ensuring both your safety and satisfaction. All tools are sterilized and individually packed for each client, reflecting my dedication to maintaining the highest hygiene standards.

Previously, I owned and operated a salon in Serbia, where I built a strong foundation of satisfied clients and aspiring professionals. Now, I bring my wealth of knowledge and passion for nails to you, offering top-tier services and professional training.

Whether you’re seeking expert nail care or looking to improve your skills, I am here to help you achieve perfection with a personalized, safe, and professional approach. Book your appointment today and experience the difference!
